kept.title: Non-2xx verifier responses now masked as "unavailable" and body discarded
kept.desc: Any non-OK reply from the verifier (e.g. 400 for oversized/malformed `leanCode`, or a verifier that signals compile failure with a non-200 status) is reported as `unavailable: true` with only `HTTP <status>`, so real verification failures and request errors are silently presented as "verifier offline" and the verifier's error payload (previously forwarded) is lost.

kept.title: Offline banner text wrong for the `verifier-error` reason
kept.desc: The banner unconditionally claims the verifier "is not configured or unreachable" and tells the user to set `LEAN_VERIFIER_URL`, which is inaccurate/misleading when the route returned `reason: "verifier-error"` (URL configured, verifier reachable but erroring).

kept.title: `reason`/`detail` from the route are never surfaced
kept.desc: The route carefully distinguishes `verifier-not-configured` / `verifier-unreachable` / `verifier-error` (plus `detail`), but `verifyLean` drops both fields, so no caller can differentiate or display the cause; either propagate them or drop them from the response.
